title: EDG Community Update: Week of November 8th
body:
**Highlights**
- Introducing '[EDG Financial Update](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-financial-update-month-of-october/)', the brand new bi-weekly cousin newsletter of EDG Developer & Community Updates.
- [Nova Wallet](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1459221723191160836?s=20) added support for EDG.
- Edgeware’s Discord server got a [DAO-oriented redesign](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1458085755079770124?s=20).
- [The waitlist is now open for Kabocha](https://www.kabocha.network/), the Kusama parachain from the Edgeware ecosystem.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3 or later](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-nov-7/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.
- Kylin Network announced the [DeData Developers Fund](https://twitter.com/Kylin_Network/status/1458038421277007879?s=20).
- 4thpillar Technologies’ [new homepage](https://twitter.com/4thtechProject/status/1459085439084732420?s=20) is live.
- Knit Finance teased their [mainnet launch](https://twitter.com/KnitFinance/status/1459155900745195527?s=20).
- Tidal Finance published a [roadmap update](https://twitter.com/tidaldefi/status/1459174963475320841?s=20).
